headerDisplay: Opens a Tuya Gate Camera / video intercom from HomeKit (accessory_lock). Optionally expose At Home / Not at Home / Dormant switches for the indoor monitor ring mode (same as the Tuya app — not an alarm panel).
footerDisplay: Tip: Leave “Show open switch” off for a cleaner Home screen. Mode switches mirror At Home / Not at Home / Dormant.

name.title: Name in Home
name.description: Label for the lock (and optional controls) in the Home app.

accessId.title: Access ID / Client ID
accessId.description: From Tuya IoT project Overview (Access ID / Client ID).

accessSecret.title: Access Secret / Client Secret
accessSecret.description: From Tuya IoT project Overview. Keep this private.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Gate Camera device id, e.g. bf3f24408fb356db59qioh

region.title: Data center
region.description: Must match the cloud project data center.

lockCode.title: Lock DP code
lockCode.description: Tuya property code for the gate open pulse. Default accessory_lock (DP 148).

showSwitch.title: Show open switch
showSwitch.description: Off (default): only a Lock in Home — Unlock opens the gate. On: also add a momentary Switch for the same open pulse.

showModes.title: Show At Home / Not at Home / Dormant
showModes.description: Off by default. Turn on only if you confirmed a cloud DP that changes when you switch mode in the Tuya app (many intercoms keep mode local-only).

modeDeviceId.title: Mode device ID (optional)
modeDeviceId.description: Only if mode is on another Tuya device id. Leave blank to use the Gate Camera id.

modeCode.title: Mode DP code (required if showModes)
modeCode.description: Exact property code from Query properties that changes with At Home / Not at Home / Dormant. Do not use motion_sensitivity or record_mode.

modeHomeValue.title: At Home value
modeHomeValue.description: Exact Tuya value for At Home. For call_mode this is usually 0.

modeOutValue.title: Not at Home value
modeOutValue.description: Exact Tuya value for Not at Home. For call_mode this is usually 1.

modeDormantValue.title: Dormant value
modeDormantValue.description: Exact Tuya value for Dormant. For call_mode this is usually 2.

modePollSeconds.title: Mode refresh interval (seconds)
modePollSeconds.description: How often to re-read the current mode from Tuya (if changed in the app).

warmupStream.title: Warm up camera stream before open
warmupStream.description: Some Gate Cameras only accept accessory_lock after a short live-stream allocate.
